blocks.source: 张巍GRE填空机经2000题 · Test 2 Section 2
blocks.noteTail: （原题及配套答案，仅供个人学习；暂不附讲解）

stem: Though we live in an era of stunning scientific achievement, many otherwise educated people remain indifferent to or contemptuous of such achievement, even going so far as to ____ their ignorance of basic physics.

Although trains may use energy more (i)____ than do automobiles, the latter move only when they contain at least one occupant, whereas railway carriages spend a considerable amount of time running up and down the tracks (ii)____, or nearly so.
colsZh: 未受阻止的；未受妨碍的

stem: The great (i)____ of most books that examine the American presidency is their ideological bias, but for most part, this volume on the presidency maintains an impressive degree of (ii)____.

Within the culture as a whole, the natural sciences have been so successful that the word “scientific” is often used in (i)____ manner: it is often assumed that to call something “scientific” is to imply that its reliability has been (ii)____ by methods whose results cannot reasonably be (iii)____.
colsZh: 被诽谤的；受到恶意批评的
预料到的；提前采取行动的

stem: Since some contemporary Western dieticians believe that the only function of food is to provide nourishment, these dieticians view an emphasis on the aesthetic dimension of the culinary arts as ____.
optsZh: 有启发性的；阐明问题的
有望成功的；前景很好的

stem: Harper Lee’s narration in To Kill a Mockingbird is ____, mixing an adult’s and a child’s perspective according to no logic other than the immediate exigencies of the plot.
The employee had a reputation for fractiousness, but his coworkers found him to be, on the contrary, quiet ____.
